methods.asr: Micro WER over chronological raw ASR calls; Unicode casefold, punctuation removal, internal apostrophes retained
methods.speakers: Optimal one-to-one identity mapping per video; duration on annotated turn spans, including pauses; UNKNOWN never mapped; not standard DER
methods.boundaries: One-to-one speaker change matching; next interval start; UNKNOWN changes included; no word-level timestamp ground truth
methods.emotion: Duration-weighted mean segment probabilities per annotated turn; uncovered turns are errors; unmapped labels excluded; macro F1 over reference-supported classes
methods.comparisons: Only shared videos, verified source and reference checksums; observational ablations on a small set, not held-out tuning

scope.data: Ten clean English synthetic selfie videos; annotations span whole turns including pauses
scope.hardware_cpu: Intel Core i7-5820K @ 3.30GHz; 12 logical CPUs available
scope.hardware_gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti, physical GPU 1; CUDA 12.1
scope.benchmark_control: One pipeline configuration at a time; fresh processes, local warm model caches, no resume; shared host, not an exclusive hardware reservation
scope.benchmark_memory: Parent RSS includes import/startup peaks, FFmpeg child RSS excluded; sampled GPU peaks can miss transient allocations
limitations: No held-out tuning or representative production sample
No speech-masked DER or overlap/collar evaluation
No language-ID calibration or multilingual/noise validation
Two measured repeats per clip, not tail-latency characterization
